description: This file defines a SpiderApp class for interacting with a web crawling API, including interfaces for configuration, documents, responses, and methods for scraping and crawling URLs.

classes.name: SpiderApp
classes.description: A class providing methods to scrape and crawl web pages using an external API, handling API key authentication and error management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SpiderApp with API key and URL, throws error if API key is missing.

methods.name: scrapeUrl
methods.description: Asynchronously scrapes a URL and returns the response containing the document data.

methods.name: crawlUrl
methods.description: Starts a crawl job for a URL, optionally with an idempotency key, and returns the response.

methods.name: prepareHeaders
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers including authorization and optional idempotency key.

methods.name: postRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified API endpoint.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles API response errors based on status codes.
